source.execution_scope: runtime Python modules and experiment YAML configs
source.scope: maintained source, tests, configs, root reviews, CI workflow, README, requirements, and pyproject

statistics.dispersion: sample standard deviation (ddof=1; zero for one seed)
statistics.error_bars: 95% Student-t confidence interval across seeds; clipped to the mathematical range of bounded metrics
statistics.null_significance: exact per-seed conditional random-label p-values retained in log10 form and combined with Fisher's method in log space
